items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: I played with Isaiah a long time.

ctx.x: Oh, wow. I just wanted to get him straight. Yeah. So I'd know who he was.

Uh-huh. Then I played with Rene and he'd come over there. As a matter of fact, I played with Rene here. But he first known me from over there. Uh, when Jim Robson used to come over there with Sam Morgan, I was a little boy then. And he used to come over there with Sam Morgan when I used to play with him. And then Isaiah Morgan made up him a band. He used to come over there. He used to play with him. I played with Isaiah a long time. And then Tom Albert come to play with my daddy. Well, he told me I was a heard me…
What kind of cornet did he play? Did he play straight or hard?

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: But after Isaiah started playing underneath, he worked out there in his band as the second trumpet player.

ctx.x: Well, that would have been Joe Watson in those times. Yeah, yeah. Who was a Yanker buddy, I could never remember. Yanker. Yanker. And Alfred on drums. I guess Marrero on bass, Simon Drunk. I don't know, I forget it.

And I think Simon played big, John played with him too. John played with him too. Yeah, John played with him too. Yeah, John played with him. And Simon. Yeah. And, yeah, I wasn't with him then. Isaiah wasn't with him then. That was his earlier band. But after Isaiah started playing underneath, he worked out there in his band as the second trumpet player. Yeah.
Well, when he got together with Isaiah, where were you living? I was in New Orleans. You were in New Orleans, yeah. So that was later here. Yeah, I was in New Orleans.

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: Oh, yeah, well, he was in Biloxi, though.

ctx.x: Okay, well, we'll get it later. Yeah. Because there's several fellas I want to look up over there, you know. Oh, yeah. Probably still several bands going, you know. I was planning to make a trip over there to see Isaiah Morgan, but he came here.
Oh, yeah, well, he was in Biloxi, though.
